verdict.rationale: Polar's core codebase is confirmed open source (Apache-2.0, github.com/polarsource/polar) with 10k+ stars, which in principle permits self-hosting, but the evidence pack contains no self-hosting guide, deployment docs, docker/compose setup, or infra requirements — all docs reference the hosted polar.sh SaaS (checkout, MCP server at mcp.polar.sh, dashboard) rather than a self-managed instance. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/deployment documentation, infra requirements, and any confirmation that merchant-of-record/tax features work outside the hosted service.
